subject.title: Setup wizard UX — don't hide selection pages on bypass

question: Should this issue change both the configured `SkipWizard` path and the in-wizard `Skip & exit` action, and which provider/model/credential selections must each retain?
rationale: Current main exposes two distinct bypass mechanisms, while the issue's definition of done neither selects the affected mechanism nor enumerates the retained selection contract.

options.title: Unify both bypass paths
options.body: Make both paths retain the minimum provider, model, and credential choices needed for valid setup while skipping only optional automation.

options.title: Change interactive bypass only
options.body: Revise `Skip & exit` but preserve `SkipWizard` as an intentional full bypass for automated or advanced scenarios.

options.title: Change configured bypass only
options.body: Revise `SkipWizard` flows while retaining the current immediate `Skip & exit` behavior.

recommendation.title: Unify both bypass paths
recommendation.body: Make both paths retain the minimum provider, model, and credential choices needed for valid setup while skipping only optional automation.

likelyOwner.reason: The SetupEngine and original wizard architecture originated in this person's merged work, making them the strongest available owner for defining the cross-path contract.
